chunks.text: Management consultancy risks with annual fee income under $5M are core appetite. Standard limit offerings are $1M and $2M. Strategy and operational advisory work is acceptable; engagements involving construction project management or financial product advice must be referred.

Risks with no claims in the past five years qualify for standard terms. Each notified claim attracts a loading. Any open claim, or a single claim exceeding $100,000, is outside delegated authority and must be referred.
US or Canadian derived revenue above 10% is outside appetite due to the litigation environment. Overseas exposure up to 10% in other common-law jurisdictions is acceptable at standard terms.

Retroactive cover should align with continuous prior insurance. Unlimited retroactive cover may only be offered where five or more years of continuous insurance and a clean claims record are evidenced.
Consultants using written engagement letters with liability caps qualify for the standard excess. Absence of written engagement terms warrants an increased excess or referral.
